geometry.physicalShape: hemisphere plus cylinder, stainless steel electrically heated shell; Figure 1(c)

geometry.experimentalStingAndElectricalHardware: not axisymmetric; downstream computational truncation must have an independence check

freeStream.source: Table I heat-transfer distribution, wind tunnel 1, final row
freeStream.gas: dry air, laminar; do not enable SST to match this experiment
freeStream.model: Lemmon2000 ideal Air OTH, Sutherland 1.716e-5/273.15/110.4, Pr=0.72 proposed

wall.material: stainless steel with electrical resistance heating; given thermal boundary, no solid solve
wall.extensionRule: none yet: prepare explicit downstream continuation and independence check before solving
wall.sign: body is hotter than recovery temperature: heat flows OUT of wall; project positive-into-wall q is negative

measurements.localProperties: edge of boundary layer; s is arclength, NOT axial X; NOT freestream Re_D
measurements.sourceReduction: published heat parameter uses measured electrical input, local outer state and recovery correction (equations 10-12)
measurements.forbidden: cannot label these values as directly measured W/m2, use Re_D in local normalization, or use theoretical curves as measurements
measurements.sourceReductionUncertainty: includes small Tw nonuniformity/conduction; measured unheated surface is not true recovery T near nose s/D<0.35
measurements.acceptance: not yet qualified: finalize normalization and experiment/reading/mesh uncertainties before any candidate
